messages:
erin: RidgeView wants a quick perf validation before we hand the commercial. Target: sustain 1.4k req/s, allow 3k bursts for 4-6m, avg output ~230 tokens, p95 <= 450ms. They also asked for a Dedicated baseline and any security blockers upfront. Call Friday AM.
marco: Confirm prompt shape and single-turn vs chat? Hosted preferred?
erin: Single-turn, prompts ~160 tokens. Hosted preferred for speed but they want a Dedicated price comparison.
jade: I'll run the bench tomorrow. Proposed plan: warm 6m -> 400rps; steps 400->800->1.2k->1.4k->2k->3k (5m steps), sustain 15m at 1.4k, 4-6m spike to 3k. Models: 13B-q4, 34B-q4. Batches [8,12]. KV cache on/off. Add X-Req-Id + token headers.
perf-bot: queued perf-job ridgeview-6789 on cluster=perf-bench-east, workers=64, eta=90s
alex: curl smoke for deck: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"13B-q4","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":230,"batch_size":8}'
jade: Smoke results (13B-q4 batch=12 kv_cache off): p50=170ms p95=700ms p99=980ms errs=1.6% (timeouts at >1.2k). Observed worker ingress queueing.
marco: Try batch=8 and 34B-q4. Reduce batching for lower tail.
jade: Rerun 13B-q4 batch=8: p50=220ms p95=460ms p99=760ms errs=0.3%. Sustained 15m at 1.4k stable. Spike to 3k caused transient 503s but recovered.
jade: 34B-q4 batch=8: p50=200ms p95=420ms p99=700ms errs=0.4%. Higher mem per host so fewer GPUs fit per rack. KV cache hit rate ~10% for RidgeView prompts.
sam: Cost sketch (prelim): Hosted: steady 1.4k rps, avg 230 tok -> est ~$38k/mo (infra + platform margin). Dedicated: reserved fleet (~8 A100-eq) amortized infra ~$24k/mo + platform fee -> quote ~$32k-$35k/mo with SLA 99.9% and generally lower tail.
sec-bot: RidgeView security asks: CMEK/KMS, SOC2, VPC peering for Dedicated. We support AWS/GCP KMS, SOC2 PDF available, Dedicated supports VPC peering; hosted can use private endpoints/allowlist. Need a short key-rotation test window. SOC2 link: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2.pdf
erin: Please upload grafana + logs to perf/6789012345/ and prepare a one-slide summary for Friday. Jade, can you draft the single-slide numbers? Marco, prepare Dedicated sizing & quote. Sec-bot, confirm KMS checklist by EOD.
jade: Uploading artifacts now to perf/6789012345/ (grafana, logs, run-notes). I'll send single-slide summary by Thu noon.
marco: Drafting Dedicated sizing/quote, will post by Thu EOD.
erin: Great. I'll include these in the Friday invite and demo the Dedicated baseline. Thanks all :thumbsup:
